verdict.rationale: The vuejs/core repo maintains a public GitHub Security Advisories page with private vulnerability reporting and at least one published advisory, a High-severity SSR XSS (GHSA-g2v6-rqmx-r4w6) with publisher and date. Only a single advisory is evidenced, so there is little history from which to judge a track record. Missing for 10: evidence of a fuller multi-advisory history with CVE IDs, a first-party security policy or disclosure-process documentation, and independent corroboration of how vulnerabilities were handled.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review the project's public CVE/security-advisory history to judge its track record of handling and disclosing vulnerabilities

citations.quote: Security Advisories. View known security vulnerabilities and report new vulnerabilities privately to maintainers.
